title: CPSC, Recreational Equipment Inc. Announce Recall of Children's Bicycles
reason: The alloy frame used for these bicycles can be prone to fatigue failure. Frame failure results in the separation of the fork, head tube, and handlebar away from the rest of the bike, causing a loss of control and crash, and posing a risk of serious injury to the rider.
distribution: REI stores from October 2002 through November 2005 for between $200 and $210 (depending on model year) full price and may have been sold as low as $125 on sale.
hazards: The alloy frame used for these bicycles can be prone to fatigue failure. Frame failure results in the separation of the fork, head tube, and handlebar away from the rest of the bike, causing a loss of control and crash, and posing a risk of serious injury to the rider.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using these bicycles and return them to the nearest REI store for a full refund or credit.
injuries: REI has received four reports of frames failing. All four failures resulted in crashes, with one child sustaining a minor injury.

title: CPSC, Petters Consumer Brands LLC Announce Recall of Batteries Found In Polaroid Portable DVD Players
product: Battery packs used with Polaroid-brand portable DVD players
reason: The battery can overheat and melt the plastic case while recharging, posing a fire and burn hazard to consumers.
firm: Petters Consumer Brands LLC, of Minnetonka, Minn.
distribution: Various electronics and department stores nationwide from May 2003 through March 2004 for between $150 and $350.
hazards: The battery can overheat and melt the plastic case while recharging, posing a fire and burn hazard to consumers.
remedies: The firm is out of business and a remedy is no longer available. Consumers can continue using the portable DVD player without the battery, by detaching it from the unit, and plugging in the DC Cord or the AC Power Adapter.
injuries: Petters Consumer Brands has received eight reports of batteries overheating, melting the plastic case, or units smoking during the recharging process. No injuries have been reported.

title: CPSC, Simplicity Inc. Announce Recall of Graco Branded Aspen Cribs for Suffocation Risk
product: Aspen 3-in-1 Cribs, sold under the Graco Trademark
reason: The screws on the wooden mattress support can come loose, allowing a portion of the mattress to fall, posing a suffocation hazard to young children.
firm: Simplicity Inc., of Reading, Pa. (The firm appears to no longer conduct day to day operations)
distribution: Department stores, and children's product stores from August 2003 through May 2005 for about $130.
hazards: The screws on the wooden mattress support can come loose, allowing a portion of the mattress to fall, posing a suffocation hazard to young children.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled cribs. Destroy and discard the cribs. The firm is no longer in business. A remedy is no longer available.
injuries: Simplicity Inc. has received 14 reports of the mattress support coming loose, including eight reports of entrapment. Five injuries have been reported, including scratches and bruises to the face and head, a strained neck and a report of a child turning blue.

title: CPSC, Meco Corp. Announce Recall to Repair Gas Grills
reason: The regulators on these gas grills, the component that controls the amount of gas released to the burner, can leak propane when the propane cylinder is connected and open, and the grill is not in use.
firm: Meco Corp., of Greeneville, Tenn. (grill); TPA Metal and Machinery (SZ) Co. Ltd. of Shenzhen, China (regulator)
distribution: Grocery, department, hardware and other retail stores nationwide from December 2003 through December 2004 for between $100 and $480.
hazards: The regulators on these gas grills, the component that controls the amount of gas released to the burner, can leak propane when the propane cylinder is connected and open, and the grill is not in use.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the grill and contact Meco for instructions on receiving a replacement regulator assembly.
injuries: There have been 10 reports of gas leaks. No injuries have been reported. There has been one report of a fire causing property damage.

title: CPSC, Family Dollar Stores Announce Recall of Spinning Star Christmas Tree Topper
reason: The tree topper can melt or smoke near the on/off switch, which could pose a fire hazard.
distribution: Family Dollar Stores nationwide from September 2005 through December 2005 for about $8.
hazards: The tree topper can melt or smoke near the on/off switch, which could pose a fire hazard.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the spinning star tree topper and return it to a Family Dollar store for a full refund.
injuries: Family Dollar has received eight reports of the tree topper melting or smoking. There are no reports of fires, injuries or property damage.

title: CPSC, CFM Corporation Announce Recall of Legacy Propane Infrared Plaque Heaters
reason: Carbon monoxide hazard. A non-specification gasket around the heating plaques could allow heater carbon monoxide emissions to leak into the area in which the heater is being used.
firm: Chant Kitchen Equipment, of Guandong, China
distribution: Heating and hardware retailers, and HVAC dealers in the U.S. sold these heaters from September 2005 through November 2005 for between $156 and $290.
hazards: Carbon monoxide hazard. A non-specification gasket around the heating plaques could allow heater carbon monoxide emissions to leak into the area in which the heater is being used.
remedies: The firm is no longer in business, and a remedy is no longer available. Consumers should discard or destroy the product.
injuries: No injuries or incidents of property damage have been reported.

title: CPSC, Dell Announce Recall of Notebook Computer Batteries
reason: These batteries can overheat, which could pose a fire risk.
firm: Dell Inc., of Round Rock, Texas
distribution: Dell sold these batteries with the notebook computers, as part of a service replacement, and as individual units on its Web site and catalogs from October 5, 2004 through October 13, 2005. The computers with these batteries sold for between $900 and $2,650, and individual batteries sold for between $99 and $179.
hazards: These batteries can overheat, which could pose a fire risk.
remedies: Customers should contact Dell to determine if their notebook computer battery is part of this recall. If it is, consumers should immediately stop using the battery as a power source for their notebook computer. Dell will provide a free replacement battery.
injuries: Dell has received three reports of batteries overheating. The incidents involved damage to a tabletop, a desktop, and minor damage to personal effects. No injuries have been reported.

title: CPSC, Black Diamond Equipment Announce Recall of Scarpa T2X Telemark Ski Boots
reason: The plastic boot cuff can crack when flexed open in an unbuckled non-skiing position, causing discomfort on the ankle or shin, making the problem evident prior to skiing and thus unsuitable for use.
firm: Calzaturifico S.C.A.R.P.A. S.P.A., of Italy
distribution: Black Diamond Equipment, Salt Lake City via [Ski] retailers, mail order and the Black Diamond Web site from September 2005 through October 10, 2005 for about $560.
hazards: The plastic boot cuff can crack when flexed open in an unbuckled non-skiing position, causing discomfort on the ankle or shin, making the problem evident prior to skiing and thus unsuitable for use.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the ski boots and return them to the nearest dealer for a free replacement.
injuries: The firm has received two reports of cuffs cracking during boot fittings. No injuries have been reported.

title: CPSC, General Electric Announce Recall of Gas Ranges Posing Fire Hazard
product: GE Monogram® 36-inch and 48-inch Professional Gas Ranges
reason: These ranges were manufactured with a design flaw that can cause an electrical arc between the wiring and adjacent gas supply tubes at two locations in the control housing of the range, posing a fire hazard.
firm: GE Consumer & Industrial, of Louisville, Ky.
distribution: Home builders and appliance stores nationwide from February 2004 through November 2005 for between $4,000 and $6,000.
hazards: These ranges were manufactured with a design flaw that can cause an electrical arc between the wiring and adjacent gas supply tubes at two locations in the control housing of the range, posing a fire hazard.
remedies: Customers who have purchased one of these recalled ranges should contact GE to schedule a free, in-home repair. Until the repair is completed, consumers should stop using the griddle on the 36-inch and 48-inch models, and the left front burner on the 48-inch models. The large oven and all other burners can be used.
injuries: GE has received reports of six incidents of fire in the control area of these ranges. No injuries or property damage have been reported.

title: CPSC, Advantage Publishers Group Announce Recall of Children's Books
reason: If the clear plastic container is removed from the book's back cover or breaks, young children can access the beads in it. This poses a choking hazard to young children.
firm: Advantage Publishers Group, of San Diego, Calif.
distribution: National book chains, discount department stores, wholesalers and distributors, and membership warehouse clubs nationwide from May 2003 through November 2005 for about $16 for the activity books and about $6 for the board book.
hazards: If the clear plastic container is removed from the book's back cover or breaks, young children can access the beads in it. This poses a choking hazard to young children.
remedies: Consumers should immediately take these recalled activity and board books away from young children and contact the company for a replacement book.
injuries: Advantage Publishers Group has received one report of a child accessing beads in the books' clear plastic containers. No injuries have been reported.

title: CPSC, Maxim Enterprise Inc. Announce Recall of Mini Learning Cube Toy Sold at Target
reason: Small wooden pegs in the top corners of the toy can come loose, posing a choking hazard to young children.
firm: Maxim Enterprise Inc., of Lakeville, Mass.
distribution: Target stores nationwide from June 2005 through November 2005 for about $15.
hazards: Small wooden pegs in the top corners of the toy can come loose, posing a choking hazard to young children.
remedies: Consumers should immediately take the recalled learning cube toy away from young children and return it to Target for a $15 giftcard plus applicable state tax.
injuries: Target has received three reports of incidents including two reports of children mouthing pieces of the learning cube. In one incident, an 18-month old girl swallowed a piece of the recalled learning cube after one side came loose. The piece became stuck and she had to have it removed in a hospital emergency room. In a second incident, a child started choking when she put two of the toy's wooden pegs in her mouth. In the third incident, a consumer reported the wooden pegs popped out of the learning cube. No injuries were reported in the third incident.

title: CPSC, Celebrate Express Inc. Announce Recall of Magic Party Favors and Costume Shield
product: Mystery Drawer and Dice Tunnel Magic Party Favors and Costume Shield
reason: The magic party favors and the dragon ornament on the shield could break or crack, exposing sharp points that present a possible laceration hazard to children.
distribution: Celebrate Express's Birthday Express and Costume Express online and catalog. The recalled Mystery Drawer and the Dice Tunnel Magic Party Favors were sold as part of the Magic Favor Box from January 2005 through August 2005. The Magic Favor Box sold for about $3. The recalled Costume Shields were sold from April 2004 through September 2005 as part of various costume sets. The costume sets sold for about $5 to $36.
hazards: The magic party favors and the dragon ornament on the shield could break or crack, exposing sharp points that present a possible laceration hazard to children.
remedies: Consumers should take the recalled magic party favors and costume shield away from children immediately and contact the company for a refund. Celebrate Express has directly contacted all purchasers of the products by mail.
injuries: No incidents or injuries have been reported.

title: CPSC, American Honda Motor Corp. Announce Recall of All-Terrain Vehicles
product: Honda Model Year 2005 and 2006 TRX400EX ATVs
reason: A safety defect could exist in the transmission, that could allow the rider to downshift from 1st gear into reverse, without operating the reverse assist (lockout) lever. The reverse lockout spring may not have been properly installed. Unintended engagement of reverse gear while moving forward could lock the rear wheels and cause the rider to lose control.
firm: American Honda Motor Corp. Inc., of Torrance, Calif.
distribution: Honda dealers nationwide from September 2004 through November 2005 for around $5,900.
hazards: A safety defect could exist in the transmission, that could allow the rider to downshift from 1st gear into reverse, without operating the reverse assist (lockout) lever. The reverse lockout spring may not have been properly installed. Unintended engagement of reverse gear while moving forward could lock the rear wheels and cause the rider to lose control.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these recalled ATVs until the repair has been completed. Please call any Honda ATV dealer to make an appointment to have your ATV repaired. The dealer will install a kit to prevent the shift problem. Consumers with the recalled ATVs have been sent direct notice via U.S. mail.
injuries: American Honda Motor Corp. has received four warranty claims about this problem; three indicating the spring was out of position. No incidents or injuries have been reported.

title: CPSC, Kids II Inc. Announce Recall of Doorway Baby Jumpers
reason: The plastic clamp that attaches the jumper seat to a door frame can break, which can cause the unit and child to fall to the floor. This poses an injury hazard to young children.
distribution: Discount department and juvenile specialty stores nationwide from January 2005 through November 2005 for about $20.
hazards: The plastic clamp that attaches the jumper seat to a door frame can break, which can cause the unit and child to fall to the floor. This poses an injury hazard to young children.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the product immediately and contact Kids II for information on receiving a free replacement.
injuries: Kids II has received nine reports of the clamp breaking with three reports of injuries, including a bruised forehead, chin and foot.

title: CPSC, Kawasaki Motors Corp. U.S.A. Announce Recall of All-Terrain Vehicles
product: Kawasaki 2005 model year Brute Force ATVs
reason: Tie rod separation caused by either wear or severe impact can occur during operation, causing the front wheel to separate from the steering control. Separation of the tie rod can cause the rider to lose control of the ATV, resulting in a serious injury or death to the rider.
distribution: Kawasaki dealers nationwide from June 2004 through November 2005 for between $7,600 and $7,900.
hazards: Tie rod separation caused by either wear or severe impact can occur during operation, causing the front wheel to separate from the steering control. Separation of the tie rod can cause the rider to lose control of the ATV, resulting in a serious injury or death to the rider.
remedies: Consumers with recalled ATVs were sent direct notice from Kawasaki. Consumers should stop using these ATVs immediately and contact a local Kawasaki dealer to schedule an appointment for a free repair.
injuries: Kawasaki has received about 140 reports of tie rod problems, resulting in four reports of injuries.

title: CPSC, J & F Design Inc. Announce Recall of Girl's Sleepwear Sold at J.C. Penney Stores
reason: These pajamas sets fail to meet the federal mandatory standard for flammability of children's sleepwear under the Flammable Fabrics Act. This poses a risk of burn injuries to children.
distribution: J.C. Penney stores nationwide from April 2005 through June 2005 for about $15.
hazards: These pajamas sets fail to meet the federal mandatory standard for flammability of children's sleepwear under the Flammable Fabrics Act. This poses a risk of burn injuries to children.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop wearing these pajama sets and return them to any J.C. Penney store for a full refund.
injuries: No incidents or injuries have been reported.

title: CPSC, Chuck E. Cheese's Announce Recall of Plastic Siren Whistles
reason: The recalled plastic siren whistle's internal pieces can detach from the toy, posing a choking hazard to children.
firm: Chuck E. Cheese's (CEC Entertainment), of Irving, Texas
distribution: Chuck E. Cheese's nationwide from July 2005 through August 2005.
hazards: The recalled plastic siren whistle's internal pieces can detach from the toy, posing a choking hazard to children.
remedies: Consumers should immediately take the recalled plastic siren whistle away from children and discard it. Free replacement whistles can be obtained by visiting any Chuck E. Cheese's or contacting the company.
injuries: Chuck E. Cheese's has received four reports of children starting to choke and three reports of children swallowing pieces of the plastic siren whistle.

title: CPSC, Toshiba America Consumer Products LLC Announce Recall of DVD Home Theater Systems
reason: A problem in the system's circuit board could pose a fire hazard.
distribution: Consumer electronics stores nationwide from April 2005 through September 2005, for a Manufacturer's Suggested Retail Price of $399.99.
hazards: A problem in the system's circuit board could pose a fire hazard.
remedies: Toshiba America Consumer Products LLC directly contacted many of the owners of the affected product. If you have not been contacted, please contact Toshiba. Upon return of the product, the firm will provide a refund of $440.39.

title: CPSC, King of Fans Inc. Announce Recall of Oil-Filled Radiator Heaters
reason: Welds in the heating fins can break, allowing oil to leak. This poses a burn and fall hazard to consumers.
distribution: The Home Depot stores in the Northeast and Midwest from October 2005 through November 2005 for about $35.
hazards: Welds in the heating fins can break, allowing oil to leak. This poses a burn and fall hazard to consumers.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using these heaters and unplug them. Return the recalled heaters to a Home Depot store for a full refund.
injuries: King of Fans Inc. has received 81 reports of incidents involving leaking oil. Two minor burns were reported, along with two reports of falls in the oil.

title: CPSC, Ideal Distributors Inc. Announce Recall of Pacifiers
reason: The nipples can detach from the base, posing a choking hazard to young children.
distribution: Various independent Mexican supermarkets and drug stores in the Chicago, Ill. area from July 2005 through September 2005 for about $1.
hazards: The nipples can detach from the base, posing a choking hazard to young children.
remedies: Consumers should immediately take the recalled pacifiers away from young children and return them to the store where purchased for a full refund.
injuries: No injuries or incidents have been reported.

title: CPSC, Stravina Operating Co. Announce Recall of Children's Metal Necklaces and Zipper Pulls
product: Children's Metal Necklaces and Zipper Pulls
reason: The recalled metal jewelry contains high levels of accessible lead in the metal and/or the paint, posing a serious risk of lead poisoning to young children. Lead is toxic if ingested by children and can cause adverse health effects.
distribution: Discount, toy, party, grocery and drug stores from March 2002 through September 2005 for between $2 and $4.
hazards: The recalled metal jewelry contains high levels of accessible lead in the metal and/or the paint, posing a serious risk of lead poisoning to young children. Lead is toxic if ingested by children and can cause adverse health effects.
remedies: Consumers should immediately take this metal jewelry away from children and contact Stravina for more information at www.stravina.com
injuries: There have been no incidents or injuries reported with the metal necklaces and zipper pulls.

title: CPSC, Yamaha Corporation of America Announce Recall of Synthesizers
reason: Unit could emit loud "white noise" when turned off and turned on again under high temperature conditions, which could possibly damage a consumer's hearing.
distribution: Musical instrument retailers and dealers from August 2005 through October 2005 for a Manufacturer's Suggested Retail Price of $2,599.
hazards: Unit could emit loud "white noise" when turned off and turned on again under high temperature conditions, which could possibly damage a consumer's hearing.
remedies: Yamaha will contact each customer to arrange for a repair or replacement at no cost to the customer.

title: CPSC, Porter-Cable Announce Recall to Repair Circular Saws
reason: The lower guard on these saws could stick in the open position, posing a risk of severe lacerations to consumers.
firm: Porter-Cable, of Jackson, Tenn.
distribution: Major home center and hardware stores nationwide from March 2004 through November 2005 for between $130 and $160, depending on the model.
hazards: The lower guard on these saws could stick in the open position, posing a risk of severe lacerations to consumers.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the circular saws immediately and contact Porter-Cable for the location of the nearest service center to receive a free inspection and repair, if necessary.

title: CPSC, Starbucks Coffee Company Announce Recall of Ceramic Teapots
reason: The teapots are labeled safe for microwave use, but the handles can become hot in the microwave oven. This poses a possible burn hazard to consumers.
firm: Starbucks Coffee Company, of Seattle, Wash.
distribution: Certain large Starbucks stores nationwide from August 2005 through mid-September 2005 for about $25.
hazards: The teapots are labeled safe for microwave use, but the handles can become hot in the microwave oven. This poses a possible burn hazard to consumers.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the teapots and contact Starbucks for instructions on returning the product for a full refund and a $5 Starbucks gift card.
injuries: Starbucks has received one report of a teapot handle that overheated in a microwave oven.

title: CPSC, Sanus Systems Announce Recall of Television Wall Mounting Units
product: VisionMount model VMSA swing-arm television wall-mounting unit
reason: An undersized shaft within the wall mounting unit can cause the product's main support component to loosen. As a result, the unit and the television it is supporting can fall from the wall, posing a risk of injury to consumers.
distribution: Audio Video stores from December 2004 through May 4, 2005 for about $350.
hazards: An undersized shaft within the wall mounting unit can cause the product's main support component to loosen. As a result, the unit and the television it is supporting can fall from the wall, posing a risk of injury to consumers.
remedies: Consumers should contact Sanus Systems immediately to request a free safety bracket and instructions on how to install the safety device.
injuries: Sanus Systems has received one report of significant loosening in the product's main support component. No incidents or injuries relating to unit failure have been reported.

title: CPSC, Louisville Ladder Inc. Announce Recall of Industrial Ladders
product: Multi-Purpose, Step-to-Straight, Combination, Manhole and Extension Trestle Ladders
reason: Rungs on the ladders could break near the side rail, causing the user to fall.
firm: Louisville Ladder Inc., of Louisville, Ky.
distribution: Industrial supply stores and home centers nationwide from November 2004 through June 2005 for between $75 and $235.
hazards: Rungs on the ladders could break near the side rail, causing the user to fall.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the ladder immediately and contact Louisville Ladder for instructions on receiving a free inspection and replacement ladder, if necessary.
injuries: Louisville Ladder has received two reports of rungs breaking. No injuries have been reported.

title: CPSC, Wal-Mart Stores Inc. Announce Recall of Toy Sets
reason: Some of the toys in these trunks contain small parts, posing a choking hazard to young children.
distribution: Wal-Mart stores exclusively nationwide from July 2005 through September 2005 for about $15.
hazards: Some of the toys in these trunks contain small parts, posing a choking hazard to young children.
remedies: Consumers should immediately take these toys away from young children and return the product to Wal-Mart for a full refund.

title: CPSC, International Playthings Inc. Announce Recall of Viking Chubbies Toy Cars
reason: The heads on the figures sold with the cars can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children.
distribution: Specialty toy stores nationwide from June 2005 through August 2005 for about $14.
hazards: The heads on the figures sold with the cars can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children.
remedies: Consumers should contact International Playthings for information on returning the product for a free replacement item of similar value.
injuries: No injuries or incidents have been reported.

title: CPSC, International Playthings Inc. Announce Recall of Toy Vehicles
reason: Small parts can detach, which poses a choking hazard to young children.
distribution: Specialty toy stores nationwide from May 2005 through September 2005 for about $4.
hazards: Small parts can detach, which poses a choking hazard to young children.
remedies: Consumers should contact International Playthings for information on how to return the product to receive a free replacement item of similar value.
injuries: No injuries or incidents have been reported.

title: CPSC, Haier America Trading LLC Announce Recall of Oscillating Electric Tower Fans
reason: Internal electrical arcing in the fan can cause a fire hazard.
firm: Metropolitan Electrical Appliance Co. Ltd., of Hong Kong
distribution: Discount department stores nationwide from February 2004 through November 2005 for between $20 and $30.
hazards: Internal electrical arcing in the fan can cause a fire hazard.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the tower fan and call Haier for instructions on how to obtain a $30 coupon redeemable for the purchase from Haier of any available product. Consumers who previously received a $10 mail-in rebate will get a $20 coupon.
injuries: Haier has received eight reports of fires or flames associated with this electric fan, including minor property damage and one report of minor burns.

title: CPSC, Delta Enterprise Corp. Announce Recall of Certain Cribs Sold at Toys R Us Stores
reason: The crib's paint contains high levels of lead. Lead poisoning in children is associated with behavioral problems, learning disabilities, hearing problems and growth retardation.
firm: Delta Enterprise Corp., of New York, N.Y.
distribution: Exclusively at Toys R Us nationwide from July 2004 through August 2005 for about $200.
hazards: The crib's paint contains high levels of lead. Lead poisoning in children is associated with behavioral problems, learning disabilities, hearing problems and growth retardation.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the recalled crib immediately and return it to the retailer where purchased for a credit or refund.

title: CPSC, Sycamore Kids Inc. Expands Recall of Mountain Buggy Jogging Strollers
product: Mountain Buggy Urban Single, Urban Double and Breeze Strollers
reason: The handlebar can crack or break, causing the handlebar to detach while in use, posing a risk of injury to young children.
distribution: Juvenile furniture retailers, baby product stores and Web retailers nationwide from December 2004 through July 2005 for between $400 and $640.
hazards: The handlebar can crack or break, causing the handlebar to detach while in use, posing a risk of injury to young children.
remedies: Contact Sycamore Kids to find an authorized repair center, to receive a free replacement handlebar ratchet.
injuries: Sycamore Kids has received 22 reports of handlebar either cracking or breaking when the stroller was pulled up or taken down stairs. This resulted in two reports of bruises and scrapes.

title: CPSC, Southern Living At Home Announce Recall of Votive CandleHolders Included with Old Taylor Estate Candeliers
product: Glass votive candle holders included with Old Taylor Estate Candelier
reason: These votive glass candle holders can break unexpectedly during use.
firm: Southern Living At Home, of Birmingham, Alabama
distribution: Southern Living At Home consultants sold these chandeliers including the glass votive candle holders at home parties nationwide from June 2005 through September 2005 for about $80.
hazards: These votive glass candle holders can break unexpectedly during use.
remedies: Southern Living At Home will notify consumers who purchased the recalled glass votive candle holders directly and will ship free replacement glass votive candle holders.
injuries: Southern Living at Home has received 15 reports of glass votive candle holders breaking unexpectedly. There are no reported injuries or damage.

title: CPSC, Retailers Announce Recall of Waterless Vaporizers and Aromatherapy Diffusers
product: Vapor-Eze Waterless Vaporizer and Vapor-Eze Aromatherapy Diffuser
reason: A defective internal heater in the recalled vaporizers and diffusers can cause sparking and emit flames while in use. This poses a fire, burn and shock hazard to consumers.
firm: Juvenile Products Corp., of Miami, Fla. (THIS COMPANY IS OUT OF BUSINESS)
distribution: Discount department and drug stores, including Wal-Mart, from June 2005 through September 2005 for about $20.
hazards: A defective internal heater in the recalled vaporizers and diffusers can cause sparking and emit flames while in use. This poses a fire, burn and shock hazard to consumers.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the recalled waterless vaporizer and aromatherapy diffuser immediately and return them to the place of purchase for a full refund.
injuries: There have been reports of 25 incidents involving these products, including at least six fires and two reports of burn injuries. In one incident, a young child was hospitalized with burns to the face and hands and smoke inhalation. In another incident, a consumer suffered a burned foot.

title: CPSC, Cooper Hand Tools Announce Recall of Weller® Heating Element used in Soldering Irons
reason: The housing of the heating element can unexpectedly leak hot metal, posing a serious risk of a burn injury to the user.
firm: Cooper Hand Tools, of Apex, N.C.
distribution: Art supply retail stores nationwide from May 2005 through August 2005 for between $10 and $40.
hazards: The housing of the heating element can unexpectedly leak hot metal, posing a serious risk of a burn injury to the user.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these soldering irons immediately and return the heating element to the store where purchased for a free replacement or refund.
injuries: Cooper has received four reports of the housing of the heating element leaking hot metal. No injuries have been reported.

title: CPSC, American Suzuki Motor Corp. Announce Recall of 2005 King Quad All-Terrain Vehicles
product: Suzuki 2005 model year LT-A700XK5 King Quad ATVs
reason: Use of an improper tie rod adjustment procedure during assembly could lead to separation of the tie rod end housing from the attachment shaft. This could cause the rider to lose control of the ATV and result in injury or death.
firm: Suzuki Motor Corp., of Japan
distribution: Suzuki dealers nationwide from September 2004 through October 2005 for about $7,200.
hazards: Use of an improper tie rod adjustment procedure during assembly could lead to separation of the tie rod end housing from the attachment shaft. This could cause the rider to lose control of the ATV and result in injury or death.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these ATVs immediately and contact a local Suzuki dealer to schedule an appointment for repair service.
injuries: American Suzuki has received seven reports of tie rod end separation, and no reports of injuries.

title: CPSC, American Public Company Announce Recall of Boys' Hooded Sweatshirts with Drawstrings Sold by J.C. Penney
reason: The hooded sweatshirts have drawstrings, posing a strangulation hazard to children.
distribution: Exclusively through J.C. Penney's Catalog and Web site from June 2005 through August 2005 for about $25.
hazards: The hooded sweatshirts have drawstrings, posing a strangulation hazard to children.
remedies: Consumers should remove the drawstring to eliminate the hazard. In addition, J.C. Penney will also notify all known purchasers by mail to remove the drawstring from the sweatshirt.
injuries: No incidents or injuries have been reported.

title: CPSC, World Kitchen Inc. Announce Recall of Immersion Heaters
reason: Moisture in the heating element could cause corrosion over time, presenting a shock hazard.
firm: Chun Tai Electric Heater Company, of Taiwan
distribution: Mass retailers, hardware and grocery stores nationwide from January 1999 through August 2005 for between $5 and $6.
hazards: Moisture in the heating element could cause corrosion over time, presenting a shock hazard.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the product and contact World Kitchen for a refund.
injuries: World Kitchen Inc. has received two reports of short circuits. No injuries have been reported.

title: CPSC, Watts Water Technologies, Inc. Announce Recall of Gas Ball Valves
reason: Gas can leak from these valves, posing a risk of fires and explosions.
firm: Fusan Valve Ltd. of Taiwan
distribution: Commercial supply houses from July 9, 2005 through August 8, 2005.
hazards: Gas can leak from these valves, posing a risk of fires and explosions.
remedies: Watts Water Technologies is providing a free replacement. Almost all valves have been recovered.

title: CPSC, Makita U.S.A. Inc. Announce Recall of Angle Grinders
reason: The guards on some of these angle grinders will not fully cover a hubbed grinding wheel. As a result, if the hubbed grinding wheel comes apart during use, it could hit the user, possibly causing serious personal injury.
distribution: Industrial suppliers and home centers from about July 2005 through September 2005 for about $179.
hazards: The guards on some of these angle grinders will not fully cover a hubbed grinding wheel. As a result, if the hubbed grinding wheel comes apart during use, it could hit the user, possibly causing serious personal injury.
remedies: Consumers with these angle grinders should stop using them with a hubbed grinding wheel immediately and contact Makita to arrange for a replacement of their guard, free of charge. Known purchasers were sent direct mail notification of this recall.
